blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Existing geometry-aware Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) increasingly rely on external 3D encoders to provide structural priors, but executing these additional encoder paths at inference introduces substantial latency and computational overhead. We propose GeoThinker-$F$, an efficient framework that internalizes spatiotemporal perception by transforming causal MLLM hidden states into predictive latent world representations. Our key insight is that intermediate semantic representations contain sufficient information to predict useful representations of current geometry and future semantics, without requiring an exact reproduction of features from a dedicated 3D encoder. To realize this idea, GeoThinker-$F$ adopts a decoupled two-stage training strategy. In the first stage, the MLLM backbone is frozen while lightweight Latent Frame Prediction (LFP) heads learn from an offline 3D geometry expert and next-frame semantic targets. In the second stage, the external expert is removed, and the model is jointly optimized to generate and selectively integrate its self-predicted priors through a specialized Spatial-Grounded Temporal (SGT) Fusion module. Extensive evaluations show that GeoThinker-$F$ eliminates runtime dependence on external 3D geometry encoders while maintaining competitive performance across diverse spatial intelligence benchmarks. It achieves up to a $3.6\times$ inference speedup, reducing latency from $1.45\,\mathrm{s}$ to $0.40\,\mathrm{s}$ while retaining strong spatial reasoning performance.
blocks.zh: 现有的几何-意识到的多式联运大语言模型(MLLMs)越来越依赖外部的3D编码器来提供结构前缀,但是在推论中执行这些额外的编码器路径会引入相当的耐久性和计算上浮. 我们提出GeoThinker-$F$,这是一个有效的框架,通过将MLLM隐蔽的因果状态转化为预测性潜在世界表现,将瞬间感内化。 我们的关键见解是,中间语义表述包含足够的信息,可以预测当前几何和未来语义的有用表述,而不需要从专用的3D编码器中精确复制特征. 为了实现这一想法,GeoThinker-$F采取了脱钩的两阶段培训战略。 在第一阶段,MLLM主干线被冻结,而轻量级Latent Frame President(LFP)头部则从离线的3D几何专家和下帧语义目标学习. 在第二阶段,外部专家被移除,该模型被联合优化,通过一个专门的空间-环绕时间(SGT)融合模块生成并选择性地整合其自预前科. 广泛的评价表明,GeoThinker-$F$消除了对外部3D几何编码器的运行时间依赖,同时保持不同空间情报基准的竞争性性能. 其实现的推论速度可达3.6\times$,将空闲时间从1.45\,\mathrm{s}美元降至0.40\,\mathrm{s}美元,同时保留强大的空间推理性能.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Spatial intelligence has emerged as a central capability for Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs), with broad applications in 3D scene understanding ( Cai et al., 2026 ; Yang et al., 2026b ; Cao et al., 2026 ; Cao et al., 2023 ) , embodied AI ( Zhou et al., 2025 ; Xu et al., 2025 ) , and autonomous decision-making ( Li et al., 2025b ) . To bridge the gap between 2D semantic perception and 3D structural understanding, recent geometry-aware frameworks ( Zheng et al., 2025a ; Fan et al., 2026 ; Chen et al., 2026 ; Li et al., 2026a ) increasingly leverage priors from external 3D geometry foundation models ( Wang et al., 2025b ; Wang et al., 2026 ; Wang et al., 2025c ) , either by integrating their features into the inference pipeline or distilling their representations during training.
By jointly processing multiple frames, these geometry models provide fine-grained structural cues that complement the semantic representations of conventional visual encoders for reliable spatial relation understanding across views.
blocks.zh:
空间智能已成为多式大语言模型(MLLMs)的核心能力,在3D场景理解(Cai等,2026;Yang等,2026b;Cao等,2026;Cao等,2023)中广泛应用,体现AI(周等,2025;徐等,2025),自主决策(Li等,2025b.). 弥合2D语义感知和3D结构理解之间的差距,最近的几何认识框架(郑等,2025a; Fan等, 2026; Chen等, 2026; Li等, 2026a) 日益利用外部3D几何基模型的前身(Wang等, 2025b;Wang等, 2026;Wang等, 2025c), 要么将其特征纳入推论管道,要么在培训期间分解其表述.
通过联合处理多帧,这些几何模型提供了细纹结构提示来补充传统视觉编码器的语义表达,以可靠地理解各种观点的空间关系.

blocks.en:
However, methods that retain a dedicated 3D geometry encoder at inference incur substantial computation, memory consumption, and synchronization latency, limiting deployment in latency-sensitive settings.
Training-time distillation ( Chen et al., 2025 ) avoids this dependency by absorbing geometric supervision into the MLLM parameters, but does not provide a dense, frame-aligned geometry interface for explicit routing across intermediate layers at inference. Dual-encoder architectures ( Li et al., 2026a ) retain such an explicit feature interface, but at the cost of executing an external geometry branch.
Our key insight is that intermediate semantic representations contain sufficient information to predict useful latent representations of current geometry and future semantics, without exactly reproducing features from a dedicated 3D encoder. This raises a natural question:

然而,在推论中保留专用的3D几何编码器的方法需要大量的计算,内存消耗,以及同步延迟,限制了在对延迟敏感环境下的部署.
培训时间蒸馏 (Chen等,2025)通过将几何导体吸收到MLLM参数中来来避免这种依赖性,但并不能提供密集,相框相通的几何界面,在推论中可以对中间地层进行明确的通向. 双相编码器架构(Li等,2026a)保留了这种明显的特征界面,但代价是执行外相几何分支.
我们的关键见解是,中间语义表达包含足够的信息,可以预测当前几何和未来语义的有用潜在表达,而不会从专用的3D编码器中完全复制出特征. 这自然提出了一个问题:

blocks.en: Can an MLLM generate geometric and temporal priors from its own hidden states, thereby eliminating runtime dependence on external geometry models?
blocks.zh: MLLM能否从自己的隐藏状态产生几何和时间前兆,从而消除运行时间对外相几何模型的依赖?

blocks.en: To eliminate this runtime overhead, we introduce GeoThinker- F , an efficient framework that internalizes predictive latent world representations within the MLLM. Rather than executing a dedicated 3D geometry encoder at inference, GeoThinker- F learns to transform intermediate hidden states into complementary representations of current geometry and future semantics. We realize this design through a decoupled two-stage training strategy. In Stage 1 (LFP pretraining), the MLLM backbone is frozen, while only lightweight Latent Frame Prediction ( Yang et al., 2026b ) (LFP) MLP heads attached to intermediate layers are trained using latent geometry features from an offline 3D expert and next-frame semantic features as prediction targets. In Stage 2 (self-driven tuning), the external geometry expert is removed, and the self-predicted representations are selectively integrated into intermediate MLLM layers through a Spatial-Grounded Temporal (SGT) Fusion module for spatial reasoning. At inference, GeoThinker- F generates both representations endogenously within its own latent space, eliminating runtime dependence on external geometry encoders.

blocks.en: Together, these components shift geometry-aware spatial reasoning from runtime external feature extraction toward endogenous latent prediction. On the Qwen3-VL-8B ( Qwen Team, 2025b ) backbone, the complete GeoThinker- F system, combined with spatial token compression, reduces inference latency from 1.45 ​ s 1.45\,\text{s} to 0.40 ​ s 0.40\,\text{s} , yielding a 3.6 × 3.6\times speedup while achieving a VSI-Bench score of 70.4 70.4 . Across six spatial intelligence benchmarks, GeoThinker- F further reaches an average score of 69.29 69.29 , demonstrating strong cross-benchmark performance without executing an external geometry encoder at inference. By jointly predicting representations of current geometry and future semantics, GeoThinker- F integrates spatial structure and short-horizon temporal evolution within the MLLM latent space, providing an efficient alternative to runtime multi-encoder architectures.

blocks.en: Our contributions can be summarized as follows:
blocks.zh: 我们的贡献可归纳如下:

blocks.en: • Endogenous Predictive Latent Modeling: We propose GeoThinker- F , an efficient framework that predicts complementary representations of current geometry and future semantics from causal intermediate MLLM states. Through decoupled two-stage training, an external 3D geometry model is used only as an offline teacher, eliminating the need to execute a dedicated geometry encoder at inference. • Specialized Spatiotemporal Fusion: We introduce Spatial-Grounded Temporal (SGT) Fusion, which employs separate geometry and temporal branches to selectively integrate the self-predicted representations. A layer-interleaved injection strategy further separates the two feature streams across intermediate MLLM layers, reducing interference during spatial reasoning and preserving their complementary spatial cues. • Inference Efficiency and Cross-Benchmark Performance: Under controlled training data, GeoThinker- F achieves performance comparable to the dual-encoder baseline GeoThinker while removing its runtime geometry branch. Across six spatial intelligence benchmarks, GeoThinker- F reaches an average score of 69.29 69.29 . When combined with spatial token compression, it reduces inference latency from 1.45 ​ s 1.45\,\text{s} to 0.40 ​ s 0.40\,\text{s} on Qwen3-VL-8B, yielding a 3.6 × 3.6\times speedup in end-to-end execution time.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1 Semantics-Driven Spatial Reasoning
blocks.zh: 2.1 语义学 -- -- 解释空间原因

blocks.en:
MLLMs ( Qwen Team, 2025c ; Gemini Team, 2023 ; OpenAI, 2025 ) have demonstrated remarkable capabilities in general visual comprehension across both static images and video sequences. Nevertheless, recent evaluations ( Yang et al., 2025a ) highlight a persistent deficiency in dependable spatial reasoning, positioning spatial intelligence as a critical hurdle in achieving human-level multi-modal reasoning. To address this limitation, existing literature has investigated several distinct methodologies.
One prominent direction involves the integration of explicit 3D information into the model pipeline. For instance, Video-3D LLM ( Zheng et al., 2025b ) enriches video tokens with frame-wise 3D spatial coordinates back-projected from RGB-D data to capture location-sensitive representations.
Conversely, another line of work emphasizes implicit geometric regularization within the latent space. RoSS3D ( Wang et al., 2025a ) leverages cross-view and bird’s-eye-view (BEV) reconstruction targets alongside denoising-style objectives to foster geometry-consistent feature spaces.
Parallel to architectural modifications, expanding training data has emerged as a highly potent strategy. Cambrian-S ( Yang et al., 2026b ) curates the VSI-590K dataset to investigate the boundaries of data scaling in spatial contexts. Similarly, SenseNova-SI ( Cai et al., 2026 ) introduces the massive SenseNova-SI-8M dataset, achieving substantial performance leaps on both VSI-Bench and the EASI leaderboard ( Cai et al., 2025 ) without sacrificing general multimodal proficiency.
Complementing these approaches, reasoning-centric optimization seeks to fully unlock the inherent cognitive power of the underlying LLM. SpatialLadder ( Li et al., 2026b ) reinforces complex, multi-step spatial reasoning by utilizing reinforcement learning paired with verifiable reward signals.
While these approaches avoid persistent external encoders and preserve standard inference efficiency, they typically acquire spatial structure indirectly through training data, auxiliary objectives, or reasoning supervision, rather than generating dedicated geometry representations at inference. Our work instead uses a pretrained geometry encoder as a training-time teacher, enabling the MLLM to predict geometry-derived structural priors internally without introducing an additional encoder at runtime.
blocks.zh:
MLLMS(Quen Team,2025c;双子座Team,2023;OpenAI,2025)在对静态图像和视频序列的一般视觉理解方面表现出了卓越的能力. 然而,最近的评估(Yang等人,2025年a)强调,可靠的空间推理长期存在缺陷,将空间智能定位为实现人类多模式推理的关键障碍。 为了解决这一局限性,现有文献调查了几种不同的方法。
一个突出的方向是将明确的三维信息纳入示范管道。 例如,Video-3D LLM(Zheng等,2025年b)用从RGB-D数据后推出的帧式3D空间坐标来丰富视频符号,以获取对位置敏感的表示.
相反,另一行工作强调暗指的几何规范化。 RoSS3D(Wang等,2025a)利用交叉视野和鸟眼视野(BEV)重建目标,同时实现去名式目标来培育几何相容的地物空间.
在进行建筑改造的同时,扩展培训数据已成为一项非常有力的战略。 Cambrian-S (Yang等, 2026b.) 解析了VSI-590K数据集,以调查空间背景下的数据缩放边界. 同样地,SenseNova-SI(Cai等,2026年)引入了庞大的SenseNova-SI-8M数据集,实现了VSI-Bench和EASI领跑板上的实质性性能飞跃(Cai等,2025年)而未牺牲一般多模式熟练程度.
作为这些方法的补充,以推理为中心的优化力求充分释放基础LLM的固有认知能力. SpaceLadder(Li等,2026年b)通过利用与可核查的奖励信号相配的强化学习来加强复杂多步骤的空间推理.
虽然这些方法避免了持续的外部编码器并保持了标准的推论效率,但它们通常通过培训数据、辅助目标或推理监督间接获得空间结构,而不是在推论中产生专门的几何表示. 相反,我们的工作是使用预先训练过的几何编码器作为培训时间教师,使MLLM能够在内部预测出几何衍生出的结构前身,而不在运行时间引入额外的编码器.

blocks.en: 2.2 Prior-Driven Geometry Integration
blocks.zh: 2.2 先前驱动的几何综合

blocks.en:
To endow MLLMs with spatial intelligence, recent architectural innovations have explored various pathways to incorporate 3D geometric representations from dedicated foundation models (e.g., VGGT ( Wang et al., 2025b ) , π 3 \pi^{3} ( Wang et al., 2026 ) ).
A prevalent paradigm introduces explicit architectural additions to stream these geometric features directly into the MLLM pipeline. VG-LLM ( Zheng et al., 2025a ) employs direct patch-level feature addition to construct geometry-augmented visual tokens at the input layer. VLM-3R ( Fan et al., 2026 ) concatenates enriched 3D features with camera parameters, subsequently leveraging a cross-attention layer to allow visual tokens to query the geometric context. Meanwhile, GS-Reasoner ( Chen et al., 2026 ) incorporates grounding-aware Chain-of-Thought (CoT) supervision to explicitly bridge the gap between object localization and spatial cognition. G 2 VLM ( Hu et al., 2026 ) introduces a Mixture-of-Transformer-Experts (MoT) style architecture that bifurcates processing into dedicated geometric and semantic expert modules, optimizing joint 3D reconstruction and high-level reasoning through shared self-attention layers.
Complementary to explicit streaming pipelines, another prominent direction utilizes feature distillation or semantic alignment to bypass the runtime overhead of external models. Frameworks such as 3DRS ( Huang et al., 2025 ) and 3DThinker ( Chen et al., 2025 ) distill 3D spatial priors directly from external geometric models into the MLLM’s latent visual representations.
While these distillation methods eliminate the runtime geometry encoder via static supervision,
they do not expose a separate geometry representation for explicit inference-time routing ( Li et al., 2026a ) .
In summary, methods that stream features from external geometry encoders provide explicit structural priors but incur additional runtime computation and latency.
Training-time distillation avoids this dependency by supervising compact latent representations, but typically does not provide a dense, frame-aligned geometry interface for explicit routing across intermediate layers during inference ( Chen et al., 2025 ) .
GeoThinker- F bridges this trade-off by using an offline geometry expert for pretraining and generating geometric and temporal priors through internal prediction heads at inference. These self-predicted representations are then selectively integrated through the dual-branch SGT-Fusion module to support task-relevant spatial reasoning over multi-frame visual inputs.
blocks.zh:
为了将MLLMs带入空间智能,最近的建筑创新探索了各种途径,将专用地基模型(例如:VGGT(Wang等,2025b.),-3\pi^{3}(Wang等,2026.))的3D几何表示法纳入其中.
一个流行的范式为这些几何特征直接流入MLLM管道引入了明确的建筑外加. VG-LLM (Zheng等, 2025a.) 在输入层构建几何强化可视化符号时,采用了直接补丁级功能外加. VLM-3R (Fan等, 2026 ) 相机参数使3D特性得到丰富,后被利用了相机相机层来让可视符号查询几何上下文. 同时,GS-Reasoner(Chen等,2026年)纳入了地面-意识链(CoT)监督,以明确弥合物体定位与空间认知之间的差距。 G 2 VLM (Hu等, 2026年)引入了Mixture-of-Transformer-Experts (MoT)风格架构,将加工分化为专用几何和语义专家模块,通过共享自留层优化了联合3D重建并高层次推理.
另一显著方向是对明确流线管道的补充,利用地物蒸馏或语义相接来绕过外部模型的运行时间管理。 3DRS(黄等,2025年)和3DThinker(陈等,2025年)等框架直接从外相几何模型中将3D空间前导分解入MLLM潜在的视觉表现.
虽然这些蒸馏方法消除了运行时间几何编码器通过静态监督,
它们不会暴露一个单独的几何表示,用于明确的推断时间路径(Li等,2026a.) 。 。 。 。
简而言之,从外部几何编码器中流出特征的方法提供了明显的结构前缀,但又增加了运行时间计算和耐用性.
训练时间分馏通过监督紧凑的潜在表示来避免这种依赖性,但通常不提供密集的相框相接的几何界面,在推论期间可以明确跨越中间层的路由(Chen等,2025年)。
GeoThinker-F通过利用离线几何专家在推断时通过内部预测头来进行预训并生成几何和时间前传,从而将这种取舍相通. 然后通过双分支的SGT-Fusion模块,有选择地整合出这些自预测的表示,以支持与任务相关的空间推理,而不是多帧视觉输入.

blocks.en: 3 Method
blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en: To eliminate the runtime overhead of external geometry encoding, we propose GeoThinker- F , which introduces Latent Frame Prediction (LFP) heads at intermediate MLLM layers to predict complementary latent representations of geometry and future semantics from causal hidden states. The external geometry encoder is used only as an offline teacher during LFP pretraining and is removed from the subsequent tuning and inference pipelines. In the following, we first present the overall architecture and its decoupled two-stage training strategy, and then describe how the predicted representations are selectively integrated through the Spatial-Grounded Temporal Fusion mechanism.
blocks.zh: 为了消除外部几何编码的运行时间上浮,我们提出GeoThinker-F,它引入了中间MLLM层的Latet Framepression (LFP)头来预测几何和未来语义从因果隐藏状态得到的互补潜在表达. 外部几何编码器在LFP预训期间仅用作离线教师,并被从后续的调和推导管中取出. 在下文中,我们首先介绍总体结构及其脱钩的两阶段培训战略,然后描述如何通过空间-全方位临时融合机制有选择地整合预测的表述。

blocks.en: 3.2 Endogenous Feature Generation
blocks.zh: 3.2 内生地物生成

blocks.en: The core insight of GeoThinker- F lies in transitioning from an execution-heavy external geometry branch to an endogenous feature generation pipeline, where the MLLM acts as its own spatial-temporal expert. To achieve this without causing representation drift or disrupting the backbone’s native semantic understanding, we introduce a decoupled two-stage training paradigm:
blocks.zh: GeoThinker-F的核心见解在于从一个执行重的外相几何分支向内相特征生成管道过渡,其中MLLM作为自己的空间-时相专家. 为了在不引起代表性漂移或破坏骨干本土语义理解的情况下实现这一点,我们引入了一个脱钩的两阶段培训模式:

blocks.en: Stage 1: LFP Pre-training. As illustrated in Fig. 2 , Stage 1 aims to cultivate the MLLM’s internal geometry and temporal intuition while strictly safeguarding its native multimodal capabilities. To achieve this, we freeze the primary MLLM backbone and exclusively train lightweight LFP heads attached to selected intermediate layers, thereby preventing low-level reconstruction constraints from perturbing top-level token generation throughout the entire pretraining process.
blocks.zh: 第一阶段:LFP预训. 如图2所示,第一阶段旨在培养MLLM的内部几何和时间直觉,同时严格维护其本土多模式能力。 为此,我们冻结了初级MLLM主干线,并专门培训附着在所选中间层的轻量级LFP头,从而在整个预训过程中防止了低水平重建限制扰动顶层代币生成.

blocks.en: Stage 2: Self-Driven Tuning. Transitioning to joint spatiotemporal reasoning, we completely discard the external geometry expert and perform task-specific instruction tuning without external geometry inputs. The geometry and future-semantic representations generated by the LFP heads are routed into the downstream SGT Fusion blocks, enabling the MLLM to solve complex spatial reasoning tasks using entirely endogenous contextual cues within its own latent space.
blocks.zh: 第2阶段:自干图宁. 向联合spatioteal推理过渡,我们完全抛弃了外相几何专家,在没有外相几何输入的情况下进行任务特有指令调取. 由LFP头所生成的几何和后期语义表示被通向下游的SGT融合块,使MLLM能够利用完全内在的内在背景提示,在自己的潜在空间内解决复杂的空间推理任务.

blocks.en: 3.3 Spatial Geometry-Temporal Fusion
blocks.zh: 3.3 空间几何-时间融合

blocks.en:
Building upon the active perception paradigm of ( Li et al., 2026a ) , we deploy SGT-Fusion across selected MLLM layers to incorporate the endogenously generated spatial-temporal priors. To effectively handle the distinct characteristics of the synthesized streams, we refine the original fusion mechanism into a dual-modality specialized architecture, which decouples the integration into an Geometry-Prior Branch and a Temporal-Prior Branch.
Finally, we apply Layer-Interleaved Feature Injection, using learnable layer-wise scaling factors to dynamically calibrate and alternate the integration intensity of these spatial-temporal features.
blocks.zh:
在积极认知范式(Li等,2026a)的基础上,我们在整个选定的MLLM层部署SGT-Fusion,以纳入内生产生的时空前传. 为了有效地处理被合成的溪流的不同特点,我们完善了最初的聚变机制,形成一种双模式专门结构,将整合成几何-先行分会和一个先行分会。
最后,我们应用了Leal-Interleaved Feature Injection,利用可学习的分层分级因子来动态地校正并取而代之的这些空间-时空特征的集成强度.

blocks.zh: 4个实验

blocks.en:
In this section, we first provide implementation details in 4.1 , followed by evaluation results on spatial reasoning benchmarks in 4.2 , demonstrating the effectiveness of our approach.
Next, we conduct an ablation study in 4.3 to verify the contribution of each component in GeoThinker- F . Finally, in 4.4 , we provide visualizations of our core designs to better interpret model behavior.
blocks.zh:
在本节中,我们首先在4.1中提供执行细节,然后在4.2中提供关于空间推理基准的评价结果,表明我们的方法的有效性。
接下来,我们将在4.3中进行一项消化研究,以核实GeoThinker-F中每个组件的贡献。 最后,在4.4中,我们提供了我们核心设计的可视化,以便更好地解释模型行为.

blocks.en: 4.1 Implementation Details.
blocks.zh: 4.1 详细执行情况。

blocks.en:
Baseline. GeoThinker ( Li et al., 2026a ) propose active geometry integration to actively select geometry features from VGGT ( Wang et al., 2025b ) as demand for MLLMs, serving as our primary baseline. (1) Vanilla regime: Following VG-LLM configuration, we utilize sampled subsets from SPAR-7M ( Zhang et al., 2025 ) and the LLaVA-Hound split of LLaVA-Video-178K ( Zhang et al., 2024b ) for fine-tuning. We uniformly sample 8 frames per scene for consistency with the baseline. (2) Scaled regime: To probe the performance ceiling, we scale the training set with data from VLM-3R ( Fan et al., 2026 ) , VSI-590K ( Yang et al., 2026b ) , MindCube ( Yin et al., 2025 ) and OmniSpatial ( Jia et al., 2026 ) .
We increase the sampling density to 32 frames per scene, and additionally incorporate 430k general video samples from ( Yang et al., 2026b ) to strengthen video understanding.
blocks.zh:
基线。 GeoThinker(Li等,2026a)提出主动几何融合,以积极从VGGT(Wang等,2025b)中选择几何特征作为MLLM的需求,作为我们的首要基线. (1)香草制度:按照VG-LLM配置,我们利用SPAR-7M(Zhang等,2025年)和LLaVA-Hound分出LLaVA-Video-178K(Zhang等,2024年b)的样本子集进行微调. 为了与基线保持一致,我们每个场景都统一取样8帧。 (2) 规模化制度: 为了探测性能天花板,我们用VLM-3R(Fan等,2026年),VSI-590K(Yang等,2026年b),MindCube(Yin等,2025年)和OmniSpatial(Jia等,2026年)的数据对训练集进行分级.
我们把采样密度提高到每个场景的32帧,并添加了来自(杨等,2026b.)的430克普通视频样本,以加强视频理解.

blocks.en:
Implementation Details. To isolate the effects of our method and pre-training data, all experiments use the same subset of LLaVA-Hound in Vanilla regime for Stage 1 pretraining, ensuring that performance differences are not attributable to unequal amounts of instruction data introduced before SFT.
To better assess the effectiveness and generalization of our design, we test GeoThinker- F across multiple VLM backbones under different training regimes ( Li et al., 2026a ) . For spatial reasoning, we adopt three incremental training settings, all using a batch size of 64 and a learning rate of 1e-5. First, following VG-LLM ( Zheng et al., 2025a ) , the training step is set to 4,656. Next, by scaling up the VSI-Bench instruction data, we increase the training steps to 19,315. Finally, we further incorporate general video data from ( Yang et al., 2026b ) , which brings the total training steps to 28,235.
The fusion ratio ρ \rho is set to 1 .
All experiments are conducted on 16 PPU-ZW810E 96GB PPUs.

blocks.en: We conduct evaluation across multiple benchmarks, including VSI-Bench ( Yang et al., 2025a ) , MMSI-Bench ( Yang et al., 2026c ) , MindCube ( Yin et al., 2025 ) , ViewSpatial ( Li et al., 2025a ) , SITE ( Wang et al., 2025e ) , and CV-Bench ( Tong et al., 2024 ) .

blocks.en:
Vanilla regime: To evaluate the effectiveness of our endogenous approach under a controlled setup, we conduct experiments on VSI-Bench following the evaluation protocols established in ( Zheng et al., 2025a ; Li et al., 2026a ) . For a fair comparison, we retain the identical VLM backbone and training data split, substituting external geometry feature streaming with our endogenous perception architecture.
As reported in Table 1 , GeoThinker- F achieves an average score of 50.7 , outperforming both the input-level fusion baseline VG-LLM-8B at 49.7 and the dual-encoder GeoThinker baseline at 50.5. Crucially, GeoThinker- F achieves these top-tier results without requiring an external geometry encoder at runtime.
This performance gain confirms that endogenously synthesized geometric textures and dynamic temporal priors, when dynamically routed through our SGT-Fusion module, supply sufficient spatial-temporal intuition while bypassing external multi-encoder overhead.
blocks.zh:
香草制度: 为了评估我们在控制下采取的内生办法的有效性,我们按照在2025年设立的评估协议(郑等,2025年a); 李等, 2026a. (中文(简体) ). 为了进行公平比较,我们保留了相同的VLM主干线和培训数据分割,取而代之的是外相几何特征流与我们的内相感知架构.
如表1所报告,GeoThinker-F的平均得分为50.7分,优于输入级聚变基线VG-LLM-8B49.7分和双编码器GeoThinker基线50.5分. 关键是GeoThinker-F在运行时不需要外接几何编码器就能实现这些顶级结果.
这一性能增益证实了内生合成了几何纹理和动态时间前兆,当动态地通过我们的SGT-Fusion模块进行路由时,在绕过外生多编码器高架时,提供了足够的空间-时空直觉.

blocks.en:
Scaled regime: To probe the scalability and generalization of our architecture, we expand the training mixture by integrating scaled spatial instruction data alongside general video samples. To verify that GeoThinker- F acquires versatile spatial intelligence rather than benchmark-specific overfitting, we evaluate across a comprehensive suite of six spatial reasoning benchmarks and prioritize cross-benchmark average accuracy. As shown in Table 2 , GeoThinker- F sets a new state-of-the-art among open-source spatial models, outperforming both explicit-encoder baselines and leading proprietary API models (e.g., Gemini-3-Pro-Preview at 62.16 62.16 ). Specifically, GeoThinker- F Qwen2.5VL-7B and GeoThinker- F Qwen3VL-8B achieve peak average scores of 66.84 and 69.29 , respectively.
Notably, our model exhibits dramatic gains on complex 3D mental modeling and multi-perspective tasks that reaches 93.2 93.2 on MindCube and 82.6 82.6 on ViewSpatial, confirming that endogenously synthesized spatial-temporal priors provide robust, transferable spatial representations across diverse scenarios.

blocks.en: To evaluate the effects of LFP pretraining and the two predicted priors, we conduct a controlled ablation study on VSI-Bench using Qwen2.5-VL-7B. All variants are trained with the same vanilla SFT data. As reported in Table 3 , the SFT baseline without LFP heads or SGT-Fusion achieves an average accuracy of 49.36 % 49.36\,\% . Adding both prediction heads and the fusion modules without Stage-1 LFP pretraining yields a comparable score of 49.32 % 49.32\,\% , indicating that the improvement does not arise merely from introducing additional trainable parameters. With LFP pretraining, the Geometry Branch and Temporal Branch individually achieve 50.17 % 50.17\,\% and 50.54 % 50.54\,\% , respectively. Combining both branches produces the best average accuracy of 50.76 % 50.76\,\% . These results validate the importance of Stage-1 LFP pretraining and the effectiveness of both predicted representations for spatial reasoning within a controlled and consistent SFT training configuration.

blocks.en: To qualitatively examine whether the LFP heads learn geometry-related structure from the offline expert, we visualize the predicted geometry representations alongside their corresponding VGGT feature targets ( Wang et al., 2025b ) . As illustrated in Figure 4 , the predicted representations consistently localize the dominant foreground structure and follow its evolving position and spatial extent across consecutive frames. Their frame-wise activation layouts correspond closely with the VGGT targets, particularly in capturing the horse-rider foreground and its structural changes throughout the sequence. These visualizations suggest that the LFP heads effectively learn the principal spatial organization and frame-wise structural regularities encoded by the VGGT features.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en:
In this paper, we introduced GeoThinker- F , an efficient framework for geometry-aware spatial reasoning that replaces runtime external geometry extraction with endogenous latent prediction. Through a decoupled two-stage training strategy, Latent Frame Prediction (LFP) heads learn from an offline geometry expert and next-frame semantic targets to predict complementary representations of current geometry and future semantics from intermediate MLLM states. These self-predicted representations are selectively integrated through the Geometry-Prior and Temporal-Prior Branches of the Spatial-Grounded Temporal (SGT) Fusion module.
GeoThinker- F achieves performance comparable to GeoThinker without executing its external geometry encoder at inference. Across six spatial intelligence benchmarks, GeoThinker- F reaches an average score of 69.29 69.29 . When combined with spatial token compression, the complete system reduces inference latency from 1.45 ​ s 1.45\,\text{s} to 0.40 ​ s 0.40\,\text{s} on Qwen3-VL-8B, corresponding to a 3.6 × 3.6\times speedup. These results demonstrate that external geometry models can serve as training-time teachers, while useful geometric and temporal representations are generated internally with substantially lower runtime overhead.

blocks.en: B.1 Model Configurations

blocks.en: We conduct all evaluations based on the 32-frame training setting using GeoThinker- F Qwen25VL-7B and GeoThinker- F Qwen3VL-8B in scaled regime. Below, we elaborate on the specific architectural configurations, feature injection protocols, and optimization strategies deployed across different domain regimes:
blocks.zh: 我们利用GeoThinker-F Quen25VL-7B和GeoThinker-F Quen3VL-8B的32个培训环境进行所有评价。 下面我们阐述具体建筑配置、特征注入协议以及在不同域制度中部署的优化战略:

blocks.en:
Layer-Wide Interleaved Feature Injection :
Unlike prior designs that adjust the injection depth according to the training-data scale ( Li et al., 2026a ) , GeoThinker- F applies Layer-Interleaved Feature Injection across all ( ρ = 1.0 \rho=1.0 ) intermediate Transformer layers. Importantly, full-depth coverage does not expose every layer to geometric features. Instead, current-geometry and future-semantic predictions are injected into alternating layers, limiting direct geometry injection to approximately half of the network depth. Because the temporal branch predicts next-frame semantic representations aligned with the MLLM’s visual-semantic space, it provides a semantically compatible complement to the geometry branch. We further assign the final injection layer to the temporal branch, keeping the uppermost hidden states semantically anchored before language decoding. This interleaved design enables consistent spatiotemporal guidance throughout the backbone while reducing potential interference from dense geometry injection.
blocks.zh:
层- 宽相接地物注入 :
与之前根据训练-数据尺度(Li等,2026a)来调整注射深度的设计不同,GeoThinker-F应用了层-Interleaved feature Injection 横跨了所有(^=1.0\rho=1.0)中间变形器层. 重要的是,全面深入的覆盖并不使每一层都暴露出几何特征. 取而代之的是,将当前-几何和后期-语义预测注入交替地层,将直接几何注射限制在网络深度的大约一半. 由于时间分支预测出与MLLM的视觉-语义空间一致的下帧语义表达,因此它为几何分支提供了相容的相容补充. 我们进一步将最后的注射层分配到时间分支,在语言解码前保持最上层的隐藏状态。 这种互出式设计使得整个骨干上具有一致的分光导出,同时减少密集几何注射的潜在干扰.

blocks.en:
Domain-Adaptive LFP Head Optimization :
To balance cross-domain generalization and in-domain adaptability, the optimization status of the Latent Frame Prediction (LFP) heads is dynamically configured: • Out-of-Domain (OOD) Transfer : The LFP heads remain frozen during downstream tuning.
This preserves the geometry and temporal representations acquired during pretraining and reduces their drift during downstream tuning. • In-Domain (ID) Adaptation : The LFP heads are unfrozen and end-to-end fine-tuned along with the fusion layers, allowing the heads to adaptively align with domain-specific geometric and motion distributions.
blocks.zh:
领域辅助 LFP 头最优化 :
为了平衡跨域通则和域内适应性,Latent框架预测(LFP)头的优化状态被动态配置: •出域(OOD)转移:LFP头在下游调试期间仍然被冻结.
这保留了预训期间获得的几何和时间表示,并减少了下游调理期间的漂移. • 国内(ID)适应: LFP头被解冻并和聚变层一起进行端到端的微调,使头部能够适应特定域的几何和运动分布.

This preserves the geometry and temporal representations acquired during pretraining and reduces their drift during downstream tuning.

blocks.en:
Adaptive Spatial Token Compression :
To efficiently scale to long temporal horizons (e.g., 32 frames per scene) without exceeding memory boundaries, we incorporate an adaptive spatial token compression strategy following ( Li et al., 2026a ) . Rather than statically compressing all inputs, we introduce a sequence-length condition: • Short Sequences ( ≤ 8 \leq 8 frames) : A heuristic bypass is triggered to skip spatial compression entirely, safeguarding fine-grained visual and geometric details for sparse frame inputs. • Long Sequences ( > 8 >8 frames) : Spatial compression is activated in conjunction with Importance Gating mechanism. By dynamically filtering redundant visual tokens, IG allows the spatial merge stride to increase from 2 to 4 while retaining geometry-relevant information.
blocks.zh:
适应性空间托肯压缩 :
为了在不超出内存边界的情况下高效地将时间范围扩大到长的地平线(例如每个场景32帧),我们采纳了适应性的空间符号压缩策略(Li等,2026a.). 我们不是静态地压缩所有输入,而是引入一个序列长度条件: • 短序列 (\\ 8\leq 8 帧) : 启动高压绕行以完全跳过空间压缩,为稀疏的框架输入保护精细的视觉和几何细节. • 长序( > 8个 > 8个帧): 空间压缩结合了"重要性"配位机制被激活. IG通过动态过滤冗余视觉符号,允许空间合并步道从2个增加到4个,同时保留与几何相关的信息.

blocks.en: To elucidate the efficiency bottlenecks inherent to 3D spatial intelligence, we analyze the computational and latency profiles across different model architectures on multi-view benchmarks like VSI-Bench in Table 6 . For GeoThinker and GeoThinker- F , w/o further token compression retains the base long-video tokenization, while the complete variants apply the additional compression strategy described in Appendix B . Other models are evaluated using their native tokenization settings. Our causal efficiency comparison is therefore made primarily within matched backbone and model-family configurations.
blocks.zh: 为了阐明3D空间智能所固有的效率瓶颈,我们在表6中的VSI-Bench等多视图基准上分析了不同模型结构的计算和耐久性剖面。 对于GeoThinker和GeoThinker-F,w/o 进一步的符号压缩保留了基长视频的符号化,而完整的变体则应用附录B所描述的额外压缩策略. 其他模型使用其本土的标志化设置来评价. 因此,我们的因果效率比较主要是在相应的骨干和模范家庭配置中进行的。

blocks.en:
Achieving a holistic 3D understanding of an unconstrained scene necessitates evaluating dense multi-view video streams to avoid missing critical spatial cues.
Following the standard evaluation protocols in VG-LLM, processing a representative 32-frame video sequence entails a substantial input context of 8,192 8,192 tokens, which comprises 8,064 8,064 visual tokens across the 32 frames and 128 128 text prompt tokens.
However, the target answers for benchmark queries are often concise single-token predictions (e.g., multiple-choice option letters or single numerical values). Under this extreme input-output asymmetry, autoregressive decoding latency becomes practically negligible, and total execution time is overwhelmingly dominated by visual encoding and prior extraction during the prefill phase.
blocks.zh:
要全面理解不受约束的场景,就必须评价密集多视图视频流,以避免缺失关键空间提示。
根据VG-LLM的标准评价协议,处理一个具有代表性的32帧视频序列需要8,192个8,192个符号的实质性输入上下文,其中包括32个帧的8,064个8,064个视觉符号和128个128个文本快取符号。
然而,基准查询的目标答案往往是简洁的单键预测(例如多选择选项字母或单数值). 在这种极端输入-输出不对称的情况下,自旋式解码延迟几乎变得可以忽略不计,总执行时间绝大多数是视觉编码和预填阶段的前取.

blocks.en:
A key empirical insight from comparing multi-frame baselines in Cambrian-P variants is that the number of input visual frames exerts a far more severe latency penalty than raw token sequence length alone. Processing a large frame count forces standard vision encoders or explicit geometry models (e.g., VGGT) to execute repeated high-resolution forward passes, creating a massive pre-LLM bottleneck.
Latent-token distillation models such as 3DThinker eliminate runtime 3D encoders. Under the optimistic lower-bound convention described in the caption, we assign 3DThinker the latency of its unaugmented backbone ( 0.60 ​ s 0.60\,\text{s} for Qwen2.5-VL-3B and 0.75 ​ s 0.75\,\text{s} for Qwen2.5-VL-7B), excluding potential output-length-dependent overhead from latent-token decoding. However, these compact latent representations do not provide a dense, frame-aligned geometry interface for explicit routing across intermediate layers.
Conversely, explicit dual-encoder frameworks like GeoThinker suffer severe latency spikes ( 1.45 ​ s 1.45\,\text{s} to 1.69 ​ s 1.69\,\text{s} ), limiting deployment in latency-sensitive settings.
blocks.zh:
从比较Cambrian-P变体中的多帧基线中得出的一个关键的经验性见解是,输入可视帧的数量施加了远比仅生代号序列长度更重的延迟惩罚. 处理一个大帧计数器会迫使标准视觉编码器或显式几何模型(如VGGT)执行重复的高分辨率前行传出,从而产生出一个巨大的LLM前行瓶颈.
3DThinker等Lententt-token蒸馏模型消除了运行时3D编码器. 在标题中描述的乐观的下限公约下,我们指定了3DThinker其未加固的骨干(0.60 s 0.60\,\text{s}的为Quen2.5-VL-3B和0.75 s 0.75\,\text{s}的为Quen2.5-VL-7B),排除了潜在的以输出长为主的间接编码。 然而,这些紧凑的潜在表示不能为中间层之间的明确路由提供密集而相接的几何界面。
反之,像GeoThinker这样的明确的双重编码框架遭受了严重的延迟峰值(1.45 s 1.45\,\text{s}至1.69 s 1.69\,\text{s}),限制了在对延迟敏感环境下的部署。

blocks.en: Recognizing that external geometry encoders create an unsustainable prefill bottleneck and that dense multi-image streams harbor substantial spatial redundancy, GeoThinker- F synergizes endogenous LFP feature generation with spatial token compression. As shown in Table 6 , on the Qwen3VL-8B backbone with 32-frame setting, purely eliminating the external VGGT encoder slashes latency from 1.66 ​ s 1.66\,\text{s} down to 0.91 ​ s 0.91\,\text{s} at GeoThinker- F Qwen3VL-8B-32frame w/o token merge. When combined with spatial token merging, GeoThinker- F Qwen3VL-8B-32frame reduces total FLOPs from 113.77 ​ T 113.77\,\text{T} to just 43.01 ​ T 43.01\,\text{T} and drives end-to-end latency down to 0.40 ​ s \mathbf{0.40\,\text{s}} , delivering a 3.6 × \mathbf{3.6\times} speedup over GeoThinker ( 1.45 ​ s → 0.40 ​ s 1.45~\text{s}\rightarrow 0.40~\text{s} ) and lower latency than the unaugmented Qwen3-VL-8B backbone ( 0.62 ​ s 0.62~\text{s} ), while retaining a competitive VSI score of 70.4 % 70.4\% .

All models are evaluated under a standardized setup matching training configurations, utilizing 16 dynamic visual patches.
In a representative benchmark scenario, the model processes an input context of 3,272 3,272 tokens comprising 3,072 3,072 visual tokens and 200 200 text tokens and autoregressively generates 157 157 planning trajectory tokens.
Notably, due to the requirement for fine-grained spatial control in safety-critical autonomous driving, spatial token compression was deliberately omitted in this downstream setup. Consequently, visual tokens are retained at full density, presenting a stringent stress test for model efficiency.

blocks.en: As detailed in Table 7 , the explicit dual-encoder baseline, GeoThinker, requires maintaining a heavy runtime external VGGT encoder, contributing an additional 2,076.1 ​ M 2,076.1\,\text{M} parameters and 49.23 ​ T 49.23\,\text{T} FLOPs beyond the base MLLM backbone. In contrast, GeoThinker- F replaces explicit 3D feature streaming with lightweight Latent Frame Prediction (LFP) heads and SGT-Fusion modules. This reduces auxiliary parameters to 1,187.1 ​ M 1,187.1\,\text{M} and slashes auxiliary FLOPs to just 14.77 ​ T 14.77\,\text{T} , achieving a 69.99% reduction in additional computational cost compared to GeoThinker ( 49.23 ​ T → 14.77 ​ T 49.23\,\text{T}\rightarrow 14.77\,\text{T} ).

In terms of runtime latency, GeoThinker incurs a significant extra execution delay of 1,461.42 ​ ms 1,461.42\,\text{ms} due to serial multi-encoder pre-processing. By eliminating external encoder execution, GeoThinker- F reduces this auxiliary latency to 598.20 ​ ms 598.20\,\text{ms} , achieving a 59.07% reduction in additional prior integration time .

blocks.en: When examining the amortized end-to-end latency per generated planning token (e.g., 32.15 ​ ms 32.15\,\text{ms} for ReCogDrive, 42.62 ​ ms 42.62\,\text{ms} for GeoThinker, and 37.08 ​ ms 37.08\,\text{ms} for GeoThinker- F ), the relative gap narrows slightly. This behavior occurs because the autoregressive decoding phase generates 157 157 consecutive tokens. Thus, the fixed one-time visual encoding and prior synthesis latency is amortized across the entire decoding sequence. Nevertheless, in real-time robotic and autonomous driving systems where perception and pre-processing throughput dictate latency boundaries, the absolute reduction of over 869.60 ​ ms 869.60\,\text{ms} in total frame execution ( 6,690.67 ​ ms → 5,821.07 ​ ms 6,690.67\,\text{ms}\rightarrow 5,821.07\,\text{ms} ) can improve responsiveness in latency-sensitive deployment settings.

blocks.en: To rigorously evaluate spatial reasoning under dynamic visual conditions, we evaluate on ReVSI, a recently introduced benchmark that updates ground-truth answers as the evaluated frame count changes.
blocks.zh: 为了严格评价动态视觉条件下的空间推理,我们在ReVSI上进行了评价,这是最近采用的一个基准,随着评估的框架计数变化,更新地面真实答案。

blocks.en: As shown in Table 14 , the explicit multi-encoder GeoThinker achieves the strongest performance among the evaluated open-source models, reaching an average score of 55.9 55.9 by retaining access to geometry features from a runtime external encoder. In contrast, GeoThinker- F eliminates this runtime geometry branch while attaining an average score of 50.6 50.6 . It outperforms strong 2D spatial baselines such as Cambrian-S at 49.1 49.1 and Cambrian-P without pose input at 50.1 50.1 , while remaining within 1.4 1.4 points of Cambrian-P at 52.0 52.0 . These results demonstrate a competitive accuracy–efficiency trade-off, although the explicit geometry encoder retained by GeoThinker remains advantageous for maximizing ReVSI accuracy.
blocks.zh: 如表14所示,明确的多编码器GeoThinker在被评价的开源模型中取得了最强的性能,通过保留从运行时间外部编码器获取几何特征,达到了55.9 55.9的平均分. 相形之下,GeoThinker-F消除了这个运行时间几何分支,同时达到50.6 50.6. 它的性能超过了强大的2D空间基线,如Cambrian-S在49.1 49.1 和 Cambrian-P 在50.1 50.1 时没有形成输入,而Cambrian-P在52.0 52.0时保持在1.4 1.4分以内。 这些结果显示了竞争性的准确性-效率取舍,尽管GeoThinker所保留的显式几何编码器仍然有利于使ReVSI的准确性最大化。

blocks.en: The sub-category breakdown shows that the largest differences between GeoThinker- F and GeoThinker occur in Absolute Distance and Relative Distance estimation. Specifically, GeoThinker- F obtains 65.2 % 65.2\,\% and 45.9 % 45.9\,\% on these two categories, compared with 74.7 % 74.7\,\% and 61.8 % 61.8\,\% for GeoThinker, corresponding to gaps of 9.5 9.5 and 15.9 15.9 points, respectively. In contrast, the differences on Object Count, Object Size, Room Size, and Relative Direction are substantially smaller. This concentration of errors on distance-centric questions suggests that precise metric estimation remains challenging when geometry-related representations are predicted internally rather than directly extracted by a dedicated geometry encoder. Improving metric accuracy and sensitivity therefore remains an important direction for endogenous spatial representations.
blocks.zh: 子类细分显示,GeoThinker-F和GeoThinker最大的差异发生在绝对距离和相对距离估计中. 具体来说,Geothinker-F在这两类项目上分别获得65.2%、65.2%、45.9%和45.9%,而Geothinker项目上分别获得74.7%、74.7%和61.8%、61.8%和15.9分。 相形之下,在对象计数,对象大小,房间大小,以及相对方向上的差异要小得多. 这种偏重于以距离为中心的问题的误差集中表明,当与几何学有关的表示是内部预测而不是由专用几何编码器直接提取时,精确的度量估计仍然具有挑战性. 因此,提高计量的准确性和敏感性仍然是内生空间表现的一个重要方向。

blocks.en: We further examine zero-shot temporal extrapolation on ReVSI by scaling the inference frame count from 16 to 128 under dynamically adjusted ground-truth annotations, as reported in Table 15 . GeoThinker- F improves from 48.6 % 48.6\,\% at 16 frames to 49.8 % 49.8\,\% at its 32-frame training budget and further reaches 50.4 % 50.4\,\% and 50.6 % 50.6\,\% at 64 and 128 frames, respectively. These results demonstrate positive zero-shot scaling beyond the training context, although the gains begin to saturate after 64 frames. GeoThinker improves from 52.6 % 52.6\,\% to 55.9 % 55.9\,\% over the same range and remains stronger at every frame budget, with the gap increasing from 4.0 4.0 points at 16 frames to 5.3 5.3 points at 128 frames. This trend suggests that endogenous representations benefit from additional temporal context but currently exploit very long sequences less effectively than persistent features produced by an explicit geometry encoder.

Across the six spatial intelligence benchmarks, GeoThinker- F obtains an average score of 60.56 on Qwen2.5VL-7B vs. GeoThinker’s 60.43 60.43 and 62.21 on Qwen3VL-8B vs. GeoThinker’s 62.23 62.23 .

blocks.en:
This rigorous controlled comparison delivers a empirical conclusion: the performance of GeoThinker- F is not only an artifact of favorable training data mixtures. When controlling for data variables, internalizing 3D perception via lightweight Latent Frame Prediction (LFP) heads
achieves comparable performance under matched training data.
GeoThinker- F matches the spatial reasoning capacity of multi-encoder architectures while successfully shedding their heavy runtime execution bottlenecks.

GeoThinker-F与多编码器架构的空间推理能力相匹配,同时成功消除了它们的重跑时执行瓶颈.

blocks.en:
Although freezing LFP heads yields marginally higher scores on isolated spatial benchmarks, we select joint LFP fine-tuning with general video mixtures as our final default strategy. This configuration achieves the most balanced, holistic spatial-temporal intelligence profile without sacrificing multi-modal generalization.
Crucially, all 32-frame GeoThinker- F variants based on Qwen2.5-VL-7B sustain an ultra-low inference latency of 0.48 s , demonstrating a 3.0 × 3.0\times acceleration over GeoThinker at 1.45 ​ s 1.45\,\text{s} regardless of Stage-2 parameter choices. 关键是,所有基于Quen2.5-VL-7B的32帧GeoThinker-F变体都维持了0.48 s的超低推论纬度,显示在1.45 s 1.45\\text{s}的GeoThinker上加速度为3.0× 3.0\times,无论阶段-2参数选择如何. 以Quen3-VL-8B为主干线,GeoThinker-F进一步将延迟从1.45 s 1.45\,\text{s}降至0.40 s,产生出3.6×3.6\时速.

blocks.zh: K.3 临时事务处

blocks.en: The temporal branch aims to model transition dynamics by training the Vision-Language Model (VLM) to predict the image hidden states of the next frame based on the current frame’s representations.
blocks.zh: 时间分支旨在通过培训Vision-Language Model(VLM)来模拟过渡动态,以根据当前帧的表示来预测下帧所隐藏的图像状态.

blocks.en:
Motivation and Supervision Scheme. Instead of employing redundant pixel-level supervision, we directly supervise predictions in the feature space.
While self-supervised representation models (e.g., V-JEPA ( Assran et al., 2025 ) ) or auxiliary temporal regularizers (e.g., Cambrian-S ( Yang et al., 2026b ) ) rely effectively on simple L ​ 1 L1 loss or cosine similarity, such a single-metric objective is insufficient for our fully supervised feature prediction target in our setting.
Because image hidden states typically possess extremely small numerical scales, lightweight or naive loss functions tend to induce trivial shortcuts, leading the optimization toward premature false convergence.
To guarantee precise feature alignment across scale, direction, statistical distribution, and dynamic trajectory, we propose a multi-faceted objective combining five complementary constraints.

blocks.en:
To endow the model with global 3D geometric awareness from a single current frame, the geometry branch learns to map the VLM’s current image hidden states geo ​ _ ​ src \mathrm{geo\_src} into global VGGT feature representations. Unlike the temporal branch, this prediction operates purely in the spatial domain without temporal dynamics.
Although each target is spatially aligned with frame ( i ) (i) , it is produced through joint multi-view encoding and should therefore be interpreted as a current-view-anchored representation of scene-level geometry, rather than a feature derived from frame ( i ) (i) alone.

blocks.en: Figure 5: Qualitative structural correspondence in standard scenes. For each sequence, we show input RGB frames (top), LFP-predicted geometry representations (middle), and the corresponding VGGT feature targets (bottom). For each sequence, we show input RGB frames (top), LFP-predicted geometry representations (middle), and the corresponding VGGT feature targets (bottom). In these selected snow and driving examples, the VGGT targets exhibit comparatively diffuse or background-dominated activations, whereas the endogenous predictions remain concentrated around the primary human or vehicle. This case-level contrast suggests that prediction from MLLM hidden states can preserve semantically relevant spatial focus when low-level visual cues are ambiguous.

blocks.en: To qualitatively assess the spatial structure captured by our endogenously predicted geometry features, we visualize the outputs of the Latent Frame Prediction (LFP) heads alongside the corresponding VGGT target features across diverse scenarios. For each feature tensor, we average its activations along the channel dimension, min-max normalize the resulting 2D map to [ 0 , 1 ] [0,1] , and render it using the same colormap. Accordingly, these visualizations compare spatial activation patterns rather than absolute feature magnitudes.
blocks.zh: 为了从质量上评估我们内部预测的几何特征所捕获的空间结构,我们可视化Latett Framework(LFP)头部的输出以及各种情景中相应的VGGT目标特征. 对于每个特性的亮度,我们平均沿着通道维度激活,分-最大将结果的2D映射常态化为 [0, 1] [0,1],使其使用相同的色图. 因此,这些可视化可以比较空间活化模式而不是绝对地物分量.

blocks.en: Figure 5 qualitatively compares the predicted geometry representations with their corresponding VGGT feature targets in canonical scenes containing clear foreground subjects and structured motion. Across consecutive frames, the predicted maps preserve broad spatial activation patterns and object-level structures visible in the VGGT targets. These visualizations suggest that intermediate MLLM hidden states contain information that can be transformed into useful geometry-related representations, without requiring an exact reproduction of individual VGGT feature activations.
blocks.zh: 图5在质量上比较了预测的几何表现和它们相应的VGGT特征目标在有清晰前缘主题和结构化运动的克诺克场景中. 在整个连续帧中,所预测的地图保留了VGGT目标所可见的宽空间活化模式和对象级结构. 这些可视化表示,中间MLLM隐藏状态包含的信息可以被转化为有用的几何相关表达,而不需要精确复制单个VGGT特征活化.

blocks.en: Figure 6 further compares predicted geometry representations and VGGT feature targets in scenes with visually ambiguous backgrounds. In several low-contrast snow sequences, the predicted maps remain concentrated around the human subject, whereas the corresponding VGGT targets exhibit more diffuse activations. This qualitative difference is consistent with high-level semantic intuition information in the MLLM hidden states contributing to the predicted representations. A broader evaluation would be required to establish whether this behavior systematically improves robustness under ambiguous visual conditions.
blocks.zh: 图6进一步比较了视觉背景模糊的场景中的预测几何表现和VGGT特征目标. 在一些低相干积雪序列中,所预测的地图仍然集中在人类主体周围,而相应的VGGT目标则显示出更分散的活化. 这种定性差异与MLLM隐藏状态中的高级语义直觉信息一致,有助于预测表达. 需要进行更广泛的评价,以确定这种行为是否在模糊的视觉条件下系统地提高稳健性。

blocks.en:
Despite these advantages, we observe two main limitations of endogenous feature prediction in Figure 7 : • Transient Non-Rigid Dynamics : As shown in the top row of Figure 7 , when fine-grained, non-rigid dynamic objects appear (e.g., a translucent curtain fluttering in the wind), VGGT precisely captures the moving geometric boundary, whereas GeoThinker- F fails to register these transient structural shifts.
This failure may reflect the limited sensitivity of the predicted representations to fine-grained, rapidly changing visual structures. • Representation Smoothness : Compared to the dense, continuous outputs generated by dedicated 3D encoders, our self-predicted features are visibly coarser and display higher spatial jitter (Figure 7 , bottom row). This graininess arises from the token-level spatial discretization inherent in Transformer architectures. Future work will explore smoothed decoder losses or continuous implicit fields to further improve feature regularity.
blocks.zh:
尽管有这些优势,我们在图7中观察到内生特征预测的两个主要局限性: • 瞬态非Rigid动态: 如图7上行所示,当细纹,非刚性活性物体出现时(例如风中半透明窗帘发花),VGGT精确地捕捉了行走的几何边界,而GeoThinker-F则未能记录出这些瞬间结构转移.
这种失败可能反映出预测的表达方式对精细而迅速变化的视觉结构的敏感性有限. • 表示平滑度:与专用3D编码器产生的密集而连续的输出相比,我们的自预计特征明显地是相近并显示较高的空间焦距(图7,下行)。 这种颗粒性源于"变形金刚"架构所固有的符号级空间盘点化. 今后的工作将探索平滑的解码器损失或连续的隐含字段,以进一步提高特征的规律性.

blocks.en: Appendix M Discussion and Scope
blocks.zh: 附录M 讨论和范围

blocks.en: We use predictive world representations in a restricted operational sense: internally generated latent representations encoding current multi-view geometry and short-horizon future visual semantics. GeoThinker- F does not aim to construct an action-conditioned or long-horizon generative world model. Instead, it investigates whether explicit world representations previously supplied by an external geometry encoder can be predicted from causal MLLM states and reused for spatial reasoning.
blocks.zh: 我们使用有限操作意义上的预测世界表示:内部产生的潜伏表示编码了目前的多视几何和短视未来视觉语义. GeoThinker-F的目的不是构建一个具有行动条件或长视界的基因世界模型。 相反,它调查了以前由外相几何编码器提供的明晰世界表示是否能够从因果的MLLM状态来预测并再用于空间推理.

blocks.en: We distinguish GeoThinker- F from both conventional feature distillation and latent-token distillation at the level of the inference interface rather than representational capacity. Conventional feature distillation typically absorbs teacher supervision into backbone parameters without exposing separately generated, scene-conditioned geometry priors at inference. Latent-token methods such as 3DThinker instead supervise compact geometry-related token states within an autoregressive reasoning trajectory, allowing geometric information to influence subsequent decoding implicitly. In contrast, GeoThinker- F predicts dense, frame-aligned geometry and future-semantic priors at selected intermediate layers and repeatedly integrates them into the backbone through an explicit fusion interface. We therefore do not claim that distilled models cannot encode or dynamically utilize geometric information. Our distinction concerns where and how geometry-related evidence is generated, exposed, and routed during inference. Accordingly, our empirical comparison characterizes the accuracy-efficiency trade-off under the reported settings rather than establishing an inherent limitation of distillation.
blocks.zh: 我们把GeoThinker-F与常规地物蒸馏和潜在地物蒸馏区别在推论界面一级,而不是代表能力。 常规地物蒸馏一般会吸收师监入骨干参数而不会在推论中暴露出单独生成的,场景条件的几何前身. 后台方法,如3DThinker,而是在自旋推理轨迹中监督紧凑几何相关的符号状态,允许几何信息暗地影响后台解码. 相形之下,GeoThinker-F预测了所选中间层的密集,相框相通的几何和后世语义前传,并再三通过明确的聚变界面将它们整合入骨干. 因此,我们并不声称蒸馏模型不能编码或动态地利用几何信息。 我们的区别涉及几何学相关证据的产生地点和方式,以及推论期间的出处和出处。 因此,我们的经验比较所描述的是在所报告环境下的精确效率权衡,而不是确定蒸馏的固有限制。

blocks.en: The reported acceleration arises from two complementary sources. On Qwen3-VL-8B, replacing runtime external geometry extraction with endogenous prediction reduces latency from 1.66 s to 0.91 s without further token compression, corresponding to a 1.82× architectural speedup. Combining endogenous prediction with spatial token compression reduces complete-system latency from 1.45 s to 0.40 s, yielding a 3.63× end-to-end speedup. These latency values are specific to the reported hardware and input configuration, while the corresponding FLOP and MAC reductions provide hardware-independent evidence of lower computational cost.
blocks.zh: 报告的加速来自两个补充来源。 在Qwen3-VL-8B上,用内生预测来取代运行时间外生几何提取,将空闲从1.66 s降低到0.91 s,而无需再进行符号压缩,相当于1.82×建筑加速. 将内生预测与空间令牌压缩相结合,将全系统延迟从1.45 s降低到0.40 s,产生3.63×端到端加速. 这些延迟值是被报道的硬件和输入配置所特有的,而相应的FLOP和MAC的减量则提供了硬件独立的证据来证明计算成本较低.

blocks.en: GeoThinker- F trades offline teacher supervision and two-stage training for lower repeated inference cost. It is therefore most suitable for streaming, interactive, and embodied settings where geometry features cannot be precomputed. Explicit geometry encoders may remain preferable when maximum metric accuracy is required, as reflected by the remaining gap on distance-centric ReVSI categories. Our goal is not to dominate external-encoder systems under every metric, but to provide a favorable accuracy-efficiency trade-off without runtime dependence on a separate geometry model.
blocks.zh: GeoThinker-F交换离线教师监督和两阶段培训,以降低重复推论成本. 因此,它最适于流出、互动和体现的无法预先计算几何特征的设置。 明确几何编码器在需要最大度量精确度时仍较为可取,这反映在以距离为中心的ReVSI类别上仍然存在的差距上。 我们的目标不是在每一公尺下主导外部编码系统,而是在不依赖单独的几何模型的情况下提供有利的精确效率权衡。
